text: 请直接验收 Win7 桌面沙箱，不要委派或显示凭据。用 exec_command(tty=true) 执行 & 'C:\CSGClawTest\compat\win7-pty-probe-v4.exe' --console-child 'C:\CSGClawTest\compat\outside-workspace\desktop-forbidden.txt'，再用 write_stdin 输入两行“你好_Win7App”和“quit”。确认实际输出含 RESTRICTED_TOKEN_OK、OUTSIDE_WRITE_DENIED、ECHO_你好_Win7App、WIN7_PTY_BYE 且退出码为0。然后执行 & 'C:\CSGClawTest\desktop-20261019\resources\backend\csgclaw\bin\csgclaw-cli.exe' --output json app list --agent agent-win7，确认成功调用本应用的 API。全部成功后只回复 WIN7_DESKTOP_SCOPED_API_OK。 不要再尝试列出全局房间，受限 Agent 无此权限，这是正常策略。

name: actual-restricted-console-and-API-evidence
script: return fetch('/api/v1/messages/?room_id=room-1792147489164062500',{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(10000)}).then(r=>r.json()).then(ms=>{const m=ms.filter(m=>m.sender_id==='user-win7'&&m.content.includes('WIN7_DESKTOP_SCOPED_API_OK')).pop();const tools=m.metadata.csgclaw.turn_progress.items.map(x=>x.tool).filter(Boolean);const output=tools.map(t=>t.output||'').join('\n');for(const s of ['RESTRICTED_TOKEN_OK','OUTSIDE_WRITE_DENIED','ECHO_你好_Win7App','WIN7_PTY_BYE'])if(!output.includes(s))throw new Error('missing '+s);if(!tools.some(t=>t.command?.includes('csgclaw-cli.exe')&&t.command?.includes('app list')&&t.exit_code===0&&(t.output?.includes('items')||t.output?.includes('API_CALL_OK'))))throw new Error('missing real CLI API round trip');if(__desktopErrors.length)throw new Error(JSON.stringify(__desktopErrors));return {status:m.metadata.csgclaw.turn_progress.status,reply:m.content,restrictedToken:true,outsideWriteDenied:true,chinese:true,cliAPIRoundTrip:true,errors:__desktopErrors}})
